summary: Spotify Technology S.A. furnished a Form 6-K with its Q2 2026 quarterly update, reporting record subscriber counts and financial results. No M&A activity, tender offers, strategic reviews, or other special-situations events are disclosed. The update is a routine earnings announcement, not a special-situation filing, and contains no transaction-specific terms or advisor recommendations.
